---
title: Agents
---

RL checkpoints and an LLM attempt playing the same start state side by side, one frame per button press. Frame 0 is the start state, the same screen in every cell. A cell that reached its goal or ran out of presses holds its last frame. Each clip comes from `python -m algoarcade.viz.video_grid` and is copied from `data/videos/grid/`.

```{python}
#| output: asis
from algoarcade.viz.site import DASHBOARD

clips = sorted((DASHBOARD / "videos" / "grid").glob("*.mp4"))
for clip in clips:
    print(f"### {clip.stem}\n")
    print(f'```{{=html}}\n<video controls src="videos/grid/{clip.name}" data-external="1"></video>\n```\n')
if not clips:
    print("No grid clip in `data/videos/grid/` yet.")
```

## What each success cost

```{python}
#| output: asis
from algoarcade.viz import cost_table
from algoarcade.viz.site import connect

con = connect()
print(cost_table.markdown(cost_table.rows(con)))
print(f"\n{cost_table.caption(con)}")
```
